// diagnostic

L0104

Private function `{name}` is never called or used as a value.

What

Private function `{name}` is never called or used as a value.

Why

A private function with no reachable reference is dead code; public functions stay exempt because other modules may use them.

Fix

remove the function, or rename `{name}` to `_{name}` when it is intentional.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0104: tests/ui/crypto_secret_generic_name_collisions.stderr.

Warning [L0104] (unused_private_fn): private function `keep_secret` is never called or used as a value.
  --> tests/ui/crypto_secret_generic_name_collisions.jet:4:4
    |
  4 | fn keep_secret<Secret>(value: ^Secret) Secret -> value
    |    ^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A private function with no reachable reference is dead code; public functions stay exempt because other modules may use them.
 Fix: remove the function, or rename `keep_secret` to `_keep_secret` when it is intentional.
